item.name: Camp_Porta_Potties
item.description: Portable toilets reserved for Treble Makers camp members.
item.readyBeforeUse: The toilet is not full, the seat and floor are visibly clean, one-ply toilet paper is available, and the toilet is open for use.
item.readyForNextPerson: The toilet is not full, the seat and floor are visibly clean, one-ply toilet paper is available, and the lid and door are closed.
item.ifNotReady: Close the toilet and tell the Dominatrix.

problem.condition: A wipe, tampon, pad, food, can, plastic, or other trash needs disposal.
problem.response: Put it in 📦 Trash_Bins. Only human waste and one-ply toilet paper go in a toilet.

problem.condition: A toilet lid is open after use.
problem.response: Close the lid to reduce odor and insects.
